notes: Coverage: every text block and every inline and displayed formula on scan007 was compared word by word and symbol by symbol against both C and H, including agreed readings. The whole image was viewed once for layout, then half_a once and half_b once in that order. Sixteen tight crops were made only for loci left open by the halves, each viewed once. No other scan, reader return, record directory, OCR, text recognition, PDF text layer, external research or delegated reading was used.

The page begins with the incomplete continuation ent and has no heading, date, signature, diagram or independent drawing. It contains two main prose paragraphs, one centered distributivity display and an archive pencil 6. There is no legible top page numeral and no written total page count. The opening fragment and cancelled incomplete Picar are not completed from context.

The first paragraph presents close relations between categories, simplicial objects, topological objects and truncated chain complexes as prospective, using qu’on pressent and Il y aurait à s’attendre. It names a possible common vision algèbre homologique non commutative. These are page statements, not findings independently proved during this reading.

The second paragraph asks for systematic study and a structure theory for categories carrying two operations, along with distributivity and compatibilities. It states that pi_0(A) is a commutative unital ring and pi_1(A) a module, then asks what further invariants characterize A up to an equivalence respecting the structures. No proof of these assertions was performed in this run.

The crop list is the list of unresolved places after the halves: second infinity-like group; strictes punctuation and cancelled article; plus underlayer; homótopique underlayer/accent/right-margin mark; commune underline; cancelled parenthesis; projectifs underletters; old ACU/AUC; loi underletters; provenant de vowel; ordinaire connector and added s; the crowded distributivity corrections; extra character in opérations; altered first operation; cancelled terminal character in celle-ci; and cancelled Picar. No settled locus was recropped.

Half a by itself settled several witness differences: the deleted la notion and de, the quote styles, the limited change of the initial letter in Lorsque, and the readable cancelled avec. They therefore have no reader crop; their changes entries explicitly identify that half-level decision so the main reader can make its own adjudication crop.

Hand attribution is conservative. The packet does not establish personal identity for the annotation hand; pen and pencil additions are attributed only to an unnamed hand. The interlinear par and à l' retain typewriter forms. The connector under ordinaire is an insertion connector and is not reproduced as an independent drawing.

H’s emph is credited for the source underlines where it appears, add/struck are credited for insertion/deletion content, and its page 6 is credited for the same archive number. H’s supplied à l' carries the same letters as the interlinear typed insertion and is not counted as a difference solely because of the macro name. Its single struck aux is credited to the distinct typed aux, while the additional cancelled pen group remains an omission.

The small high right-margin mark beside the real homóto- division hyphen is retained with uncertainty. It has visible strokes but no established textual function and may be a reproduction blemish; the transcription does not make it a letter of homótopique. Other large margin spots and page-border traces were observed as nontextual scan/page blemishes.

Resolved C doubts include the compact cancelled (p.ex.), the shared initial p and old or beneath ro in projectifs, old str under loi, old a under e in provenant de, the added handwritten s in des, old e in évidents, and extra deleted a in opérations. The second infinity-like group and fusion plus underlayer have revised candidate priorities. Remaining masked groups retain explicit uncertainty.
Only file/schema and transcription coverage validation was performed after reading. No visual comparison has been counted as a mathematical proof check, and math_checks is intentionally empty.
